provider: Systemfreaks — S3-compatible object storage, 250 GB free during beta (coupon STRBETA)

free_tier.stated: 250 GB free during beta, 'and bandwidth is free'. Post-beta: $0.0050/GB storage ($5/TB/mo) with 1 TB bandwidth included then $1.00/TB.

egress.terms: Free during beta; after beta 1 TB included then $1/TB — which is the cheapest published egress in the slot but still metered, so it fails a user's 'free or CF-covered' rule once beta ends.

tooling: Real S3-compatible endpoint — rclone s3, s3cmd, aws-cli, any S3 SDK. Provider also ships an S3 backup plugin and an offload plugin for WordPress.
chaining: No stated per-account cap on beta accounts beyond the 250 GB; the coupon code is public in the LET thread. Beta gating means the allowance is per account and the open question is how many accounts beta admits, not a durable design.
limits_note: 250 GB cap. Beta status: signup queues you ('after registration you will receive an email once the service launches'). Post-beta pricing is metered egress.
reliability_note: Small provider mixing colo and rented dedicated servers; explicitly admits rented capacity in lower-demand regions. Beta; the 250 GB grant's survival is the risk.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'During the beta, it's free for up to 250 GB of storage with the coupon STRBETA, and bandwidth is free. After the beta … Storage: $0.0050/GB … Bandwidth: 1 TB included then $1.00/TB'
probe: GET -> HTTP 302 (redirect to login; site alive, beta status unverified)
